The '''''Savareen Dancer''''' was a relatively well-known [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]]<ref name="GG9" /> that shared its name with the [[Savareen system/Legends|Savareen system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and was active in the Outer Rim during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Savareen Dancer'' was mentioned in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', which was authored by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="GG9" />
